description: Stayed out of the lane, and would not have the chalk read.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Brought the number from the stair, and did not bar the street door.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stayed in, and was not asked to bar the door.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Was not in the lane, and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Heard it, and did not claim to have seen it.
name: William Shakespeare
